scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend,analytics -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --workspace=src/frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=src/backend" "npm run dev:analytics"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=src/frontend && npm run build --workspace=src/backend
scripts.start: concurrently -n frontend,backend,analytics -c blue,green,yellow "npm run start --workspace=src/frontend" "npm run start --workspace=src/backend" "npm run start:analytics"
scripts.format: npm run format --workspace=src/frontend && npm run format --workspace=src/backend
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace=src/frontend && npm run format:check --workspace=src/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=src/frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace=src/backend
